text:
Anna: Heads-up — noticed a gap between routing-policy attribution and SDK telemetry on a customer's Dedicated cluster. console shows requests routed to `fast-tier` but SDK sampling sometimes tags them as `default`. This skews quota dashboards. :eyes:
Mike: Can you paste an example header payload? suspect header-casing or a shim mismatch.
Anna: yeah, here's a raw example we captured in the proxy logs:
```
X-Route-Policy: fast-tier
x-route-policy: fast-tier
X-Route-Src: sdk-python/1.2.0
```
Ravi: Ah, duplicate-casing. Some of our Python client libs lowercase headers when we serialize the internal meta. Console ingestion normalizes to Title-Case and then dedupes — the canonicalizer picks the first seen key and ends up reading `default`.
Sara: hmm. That explains misattribution spikes in the tenant's quota burn graph. We saw a 12% bump last week.
Jess: Two potential fixes: 1) normalize headers at the proxy to prefer our canonical `X-Route-Policy` (safe, quick); 2) change SDK emitter to use canonical casing + single header (breaking for any infra that relied on dupes).
Mike: We should avoid a breaking change in patch releases. Can we add a proxy fix with a canary rollout to Dedicated only first? deploy-bot: Canary rollout started on cluster: ded-42 at 11:03 UTC.
Ravi: Also adding a defensive parsing step in Console ingestion would help: if both title-case and lowercase exist, prefer the non-empty and validate against known policies set. Non-breaking and immediate.
Anna: I like the triple approach: ingestion fallback + proxy normalization + SDK non-breaking warning in next minor. Roadmap: ingestion hotfix today, proxy canary this week, SDK minor next sprint.
Sara: For telemetry, we should emit a sampling flag `x-route-policy-source` so downstream graphs can filter by source-of-truth while we roll this out. Example: `x-route-policy-source: proxy|sdk|ingest`.
Jess: That extra header will help debugging but watch ACL/KMS stripping in Private deployments — some customers strip unknown headers. Might need to put source into the `X-Route-Meta` JSON blob instead:
```json
{"policy":"fast-tier","source":"proxy"}
```
Ravi: Agreed re: Private. Suggest fallback order: proxy header -> X-Route-Meta -> SDK header. Ingestion will implement that.
Mike: Who wants the action for console changes? Anna, can you file the dashboard PR for quota mapping and add a note to the alert runbook?
Anna: Yep, I'll open the PR and add runbook changes. Assigning follow-ups: Anna (dashboard + runbook), Mike (proxy canary + rollout), Ravi (ingest parsing + sampling flag), Jess (SDK changelog + warning).
Sara: Quick UX note — when we flip normalization, the console should annotate historical data adjustments. Otherwise support will get 50 pings.
Anna: Good call. I'll add an interim annotation and a short blurb for the tenant-facing changelog. :thumbsup:
